description.value: Sempre Uno ('Forever 1') is a well-established Italian restaurant occupying a historic corner at 1 Lonsdale Ave in North Vancouver, founded by Antonio Corsi in the early 1980s on the site of a former shipyard café. Over four decades it has grown into one of Greater Vancouver's most popular Italian dining destinations, drawing guests from around the world. The menu focuses on regional Italian fusion with house-made pastas and classic antipasti in an upscale but welcoming atmosphere.
